caption: The drawing features two representations of a fish-like figure with exaggerated features, both located on an otherwise plain, beige background. In the upper left quadrant, there is a detailed, shaded depiction of a fish in grayscale. This fish is shown upright, with a large open mouth forming a circular shape, prominent lips, an expressive round eye, and fins and scales rendered with fine, dark tones. Slightly below and to the right, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing of a similar fish, oriented in a similar position, showing an open mouth, a round eye, visible scales, fin details, and a curled tail. In the upper left corner of the paper, the artist's handwritten signature and the year "1938" are present. The overall composition is sparse, with the two fish images as the only prominent elements on the page.
title: Dolphin Ornament
